stories.title: Follow live: Halpin's two-run homer puts Guardians back on top
Eagles QB Hurts ruled out vs. Panthers with blood clot in calf
stories.summary: Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Panthers due to a superficial blood clot in his calf.

stories.title: Sources: CFP nearing deal for 24-team format beginning in '27
stories.summary: The College Football Playoff is nearing a deal to expand to 24 teams, sources told ESPN's Pete Thamel, with the new format expected to begin in 2027.

stories.title: Jacobs sues to block release of records, video of altercation with woman
stories.summary: The Packers' Josh Jacobs has filed a civil suit seeking a permanent injunction restricting access to records from his May 23 altercation with a woman.

stories.title: NBA GMs project Wembanyama, Spurs to hoist hardware
stories.summary: An annual survey of NBA GMs projects the Spurs to win the NBA title this season, with Victor Wembanyama earning MVP and Defensive Player of the Year honors.
